'''Settlement Chronicle''' records the fictional history of the eight-star network. The dates below belong to the setting, not to the scientific entries about [[Sol]].

== First passage ==
In 2318 a joint expedition opened the route to [[Asterion]]. Settlers built [[Daybreak]], while supply crews established farms on [[Orchard]]. Their shared charter became the foundation of the [[Solar Concord]].

== The foundry years ==
In 2352 engineers reached [[Cinder]] and began constructing permanent gate housings. The foundries later united as the [[Crucible Combine]]. Industry expanded into [[Vesper]], and passage fees divided the original alliance.

== Independent ports ==
By 2386 the ports of [[Pelagos]] and [[Halcyon]] had formed the [[Free Tide]]. A customs dispute nearly closed the trade network. A limited passage treaty restored commerce without resolving ownership of the gates.

== The present crisis ==
In 2411 a survey team on [[Reliquary]] detected the [[Nacre Beacon]]. Within weeks a ship returning from [[Silent Reach]] reported a missing interval in its log. All three powers sent observers to [[Beacon Watch]]. None agrees on who should control the next expedition.
